description.value: Eagle's Nest Guest Suite is a private vacation rental suite perched atop a bluff on the Paragon Estate between Peachland and Summerland, offering sweeping views of Okanagan Lake and access to a shared 300-foot private lakefront. The suite sleeps up to four guests across King and Queen bedrooms plus a pull-out sofa, and is booked exclusively through Airbnb. The Okanagan Rail Trail and Peachland Rotary Trail are accessible in the area, making this a scenic base for cycle touring.

The property is operated remotely via Airbnb with no evidence of on-site staff, making bike procedure verification impossible from available evidence.
